provenance.title: 286 High Complexity Files
provenance.metric: architectureIssues["N High Complexity Files"] — analyzed files where calcComplexity(content).level === "critical", i.e. 1 + Σ(branch-regex hits) > 30 over the RAW file text, comments and string literals included (index.html:1663-1685, 5453-5454)
provenance.method: git ls-files over the tracked tree, score only CODE_EXTS members, 1 + Σ(24 branch-regex hits) over RAW text, critical ⇔ score > 30 (index.html:1663-1685, 5453-5454)
provenance.beforeNote: the filed list is a superset: 93 of the 286 are .mts (never scored by the analyzer), 2 score below the ceiling, and the tree advanced past analyzedAt (7 critical files are not in the filed list). The envelope is therefore measured, not copied.
provenance.driftNote: `filedBaseline` is the architecture's measurement at e075a867 (198 critical). `before` is the same mirror re-run on the merge base this branch landed on (origin/main 434bcfde, 204 critical). Main's own refactors added and removed flags between the two, so acceptance is the DROP against `before`, not the filed count.
provenance.notScoredNote: one cited .mts path (.pi/extensions/agent-harness/test/index-cascade.test.mts) no longer exists — renamed since analyzedAt, so 93 of the 94 cited .mts paths are recorded.
provenance.afterNote: `after` is measured in-gate over the delivered tracked tree; the split adds files, so `after.files`/`after.codeFiles` exceed `before` — the drop is not from deleting files.

tradeoffs.coupling: `N Highly Coupled` rises as siblings reference the same defining files — the accepted cost of a responsibility split (already measured 101 → 116 for #2003).
tradeoffs.scope: 12 families / 87 parts, not the whole 198-file flag set: the envelope ratchet plus `deferred{requires}` makes the remainder auditable instead of pretending one PR closes the title.
tradeoffs.rejected: the #2003 TOUCHED-manifest ratchet (constrains only listed files, which is how the count grew from 202 to 286) and splitting cohesive modules to satisfy a text metric (run-lock.ts, timed-map.ts, harness-state.ts, load-config.ts).
